content.title: LendingTree (NASDAQ:TREE) Delivers Strong Q3 CY2025 Numbers
content.summary: Financial marketplace platform LendingTree (NASDAQ:TREE) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 18% year on year to $307.8 million. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($285 million at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 7.2% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.70 per share was 46.8% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
